audit.whatIsWrong: Full rows 5 and 6 read 'Skill' while content win[5] and win[6] both read 'Zed' — two answers to the same question, and the packet agrees with content.
audit.why: Zed is 57.03% over 910 games. Taliyah has no true dash: Seismic Shove repositions but does not break the Death Mark recast, and she is squishy once the gap is closed.
audit.corrected: Full phases[5].side and phases[6].side moved to Zed. Both whys already described Zed winning those stages, so no why edit was needed and no no-op win[N] edit was proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ratings sat at 6/10 on the two stages Zed decisively owns.
audit.why: Level 6 into a dashless target and first-item lethality are the spikes; Taliyah's spike is roam pressure on Weaver's Wall, which is a map effect rather than a lane one.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup was never stated in the trading, cooldown or don'ts fields: Unraveled Earth's mines detonate and STUN when an enemy dashes through them or is knocked through them. Zed's Living Shadow and Death Mark are both dashes, so the minefield is a hard counter to the commit. Weaver's Wall creating terrain across the escape route was also never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' Riot's R text: she creates a very long wall. The kit's terrain flag confirms it blocks paths and dashes.
audit.corrected: Stated in tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.carry, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, enemyWin and report[3].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[2].d asserted a 'fifteen-second' Seismic Shove window that the kit does not support.
audit.why: Seismic Shove is 14/12.5/11/9.5/8, not 15s at any rank.
audit.corrected: Seismic Shove 14s at rank 1 down to 8s, Unraveled Earth a flat 14s, Threaded Volley 7s to 3s, Weaver's Wall 180s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Taliyah was called 'he/his/him' in fifteen fields, and two Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists taliyah as female; the lint named each field.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and both bleeds replaced with bodies matching their titles. report[4].t and report[11].t left for the two-report cap.

audit.why: The kit's derived flags mark Threaded Volley and Seismic Shove as 'grounding'. Riot's own text for both describes no grounding effect — Q slows off Worked Ground, W throws enemies. Per the brief's instruction, the description wins.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim was written anywhere. The real dash-denial in this matchup is the Unraveled Earth stun and the Weaver's Wall terrain, and those are what the edits say.
sources: brief enemyKit Riot text vs derived flags

audit.whatIsWrong: QA pass: matchup-lint and regression-check still reported findings on this matchup after the proposing pass.
audit.why: Edits from the earlier pass were rejected by apply-proposals (length drift, or a phrase matching the non-interaction filter), so the defects survived on disk.
